source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.zh: 欽寂弟欽明，少以軍功歷左玉鈐衛將軍、安西大都護，封鹽山郡公。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.literal: Qinji's younger brother Qinming—from youth through military merit he rose through General of the Left Jade Bell Guard, Grand Protector of Anxi, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Yanshan Commandery.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.idiomatic: Qinji's younger brother Qinming, through military merit from youth, rose to general of the Left Jade Bell Guard, grand protector of Anxi, and was enfeoffed as Duke of Yanshan commandery.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.zh: 萬歲通天元年，授金紫光祿大夫、涼州都督。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.literal: In the first year of the Wansui Tongtian era, he was appointed Grand Master for Splendid Happiness bearing the Purple Bag and Area Commander of Liang.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.idiomatic: In the first year of the Wansui Tongtian era, he was appointed grand master for splendid happiness bearing the purple bag and area commander of Liang.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.zh: 欽明嘗出按部，突厥默啜率眾數萬奄至城下，欽明拒戰。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.literal: Qinming once went out to inspect his district; the Turk Mochuo led tens of thousands of men in a sudden descent to the walls, and Qinming resisted in battle.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.idiomatic: Qinming once went out to inspect his district when the Turk Mochuo led tens of thousands of men in a sudden descent to the walls. Qinming resisted in battle.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.literal: After a long while, his strength gave way and he was captured.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.idiomatic: After a long while his strength gave way and he was captured.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.zh: 賊將欽明至靈州城下，令說城中早降，欽明大呼曰：「賊中都無飲食，城內有美醬，乞二升，粱米乞二斗，墨乞一梃。」
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.literal: The rebels brought Qinming to Ling Prefecture below the walls and ordered him to urge the city to surrender early. Qinming cried out: "The bandits have no food or drink at all! Inside the city there is fine sauce—give me two sheng; millet—give me two dou; and one stick of ink!"
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.idiomatic: The rebels brought Qinming to Ling Prefecture below the walls and ordered him to urge the city to surrender early. Qinming cried out: "The bandits have no food or drink at all! Inside the city there is fine sauce—give me two sheng; millet—give me two dou; and one stick of ink!"

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.zh: 是時，賊營處四面阻泥河，惟有一路得入，欽明乞此物以喻城中，冀其簡兵陳將，候夜掩襲，城中無悟其旨者，尋遇害。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.literal: At that time the bandit camp was hemmed in on four sides by muddy streams; only one road allowed entry. Qinming begged for these items to signal the city, hoping they would choose troops and deploy generals for a night raid, but those in the city did not grasp his meaning, and he was soon killed.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.idiomatic: At that time the bandit camp was hemmed in on four sides by muddy streams, with only one road in. Qinming begged for these items to signal the city, hoping they would choose troops and deploy generals for a night raid, but those in the city did not grasp his meaning and he was soon killed.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.zh: 兄弟同年皆死王事，論者稱之。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.literal: The brothers died the same year in the ruler's service; commentators praised them.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2026d8e.idiomatic: The brothers died the same year in the ruler's service, and commentators praised them.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.zh: 柔遠子皎，長安中，累遷尚衣奉御。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.literal: Ruyuan's son Jiao—in the Chang'an era, through successive promotions he reached Palace Attendant for Imperial Robes.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.idiomatic: Ruyuan's son Jiao, during the Chang'an era, rose through successive promotions to palace attendant for imperial robes.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.literal: At the time, while Xuanzong was in his princely domain, he saw Jiao and was pleased with him.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.idiomatic: At the time, while Xuanzong was in his princely domain, he saw Jiao and was pleased with him.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.zh: 皎察玄宗有非常之度，尤委心焉。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.literal: Jiao perceived that Xuanzong possessed an extraordinary capacity, and gave him his heart above all others.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.idiomatic: Jiao perceived that Xuanzong possessed extraordinary capacity and gave him his heart above all others.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.literal: Soon he was sent out as chief administrator of Run Prefecture.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.idiomatic: Soon he was sent out as chief administrator of Run Prefecture.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.zh: 玄宗即位，召拜殿中少監。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.literal: When Xuanzong ascended the throne, Jiao was summoned and appointed deputy director of the Palace Directorate.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.idiomatic: When Xuanzong ascended the throne, Jiao was summoned and appointed deputy director of the palace directorate.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.zh: 數召入臥內，命之舍敬，曲侍宴私，與后妃連榻，間以擊球鬥雞，常呼之為姜七而不名也。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.literal: He was repeatedly summoned into the sleeping chamber; the emperor dispensed with formality, treating him privately at banquets, sharing couches with the empress and consorts, occasionally playing polo and cockfighting with him, and often called him "Jiang Seven" rather than by name.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.idiomatic: He was repeatedly summoned into the sleeping chamber. The emperor dispensed with formality, treated him privately at banquets, shared couches with the empress and consorts, occasionally played polo and cockfighting with him, and often called him "Jiang Seven" rather than by name.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.zh: 兼賜以宮女、名馬及諸珍物不可勝數。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.literal: He was also granted palace women, famous horses, and countless precious objects.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.idiomatic: He was also granted palace women, famous horses, and countless precious objects.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.zh: 玄宗又嘗與皎在殿庭玩一嘉樹，皎稱其美，玄宗遽令徙植於其家，其寵遇如此。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.literal: Xuanzong once admired a fine tree with Jiao in the palace courtyard; when Jiao praised its beauty, Xuanzong immediately ordered it transplanted to Jiao's home—such was the favor shown him.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.idiomatic: Xuanzong once admired a fine tree with Jiao in the palace courtyard. When Jiao praised its beauty, Xuanzong immediately ordered it transplanted to Jiao's home—such was the favor shown him.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.zh: 及竇懷貞等潛謀逆亂，玄宗將討之，皎協贊謀議，以功拜殿中監，封楚國公，實封四百戶。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.literal: When Dou Huaizhen and others secretly plotted rebellion and Xuanzong prepared to suppress them, Jiao joined in planning and deliberation; for his merit he was appointed director of the Palace Directorate, enfeoffed as Duke of the State of Chu, with a substantive fief of four hundred households.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.idiomatic: When Dou Huaizhen and others secretly plotted rebellion and Xuanzong prepared to suppress them, Jiao joined in the planning. For his merit he was appointed director of the palace directorate, enfeoffed as Duke of the State of Chu, with a substantive fief of four hundred households.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.zh: 玄宗以皎在籓之舊，皎又有先見之明，欲宣佈其事，乃下敕曰：
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.literal: Because Jiao had been an old companion from the princely days and had also shown foresight, Xuanzong wished to proclaim these matters, and thereupon issued an edict saying:
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-2ba685e.idiomatic: Because Jiao had been an old companion from the princely days and had also shown foresight, Xuanzong wished to proclaim these matters and thereupon issued an edict saying:

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.zh: 天寶六載，授皎男慶初等官。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.literal: In the sixth year of Tianbao, Jiao's son Qingchu and others were granted offices.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tianbao, Jiao's son Qingchu and others were granted offices.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.zh: 七載，贈皎吏部尚書，仍贈實封二百戶以充享祀。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.literal: In the seventh year, Jiao was posthumously given Minister of the Civil Service and a substantive fief of two hundred households for sacrificial provision.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.idiomatic: In the seventh year, Jiao was posthumously made minister of the civil service and given a substantive fief of two hundred households for sacrificial provision.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.literal: Qingchu inherited the enfeoffment as Duke of the State of Chu.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.idiomatic: Qingchu inherited the enfeoffment as Duke of the State of Chu.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.zh: 慶初生未晬，玄宗許尚公主，後淪落二十餘年。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.literal: Qingchu was not yet a year old when born; Xuanzong promised he would marry a princess, but afterward he lapsed into neglect for more than twenty years.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.idiomatic: Qingchu was not yet a year old when born. Xuanzong promised he would marry a princess, but afterward he lapsed into neglect for more than twenty years.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.zh: 李林甫為相，當軸用事，林甫即皎之甥，從容奏之，故驟加恩命。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.literal: When Li Linfu became chief minister and held real power at court, Li Linfu—Jiao's nephew—spoke of the matter at leisure in memorial, and therefore sudden honors were conferred.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.idiomatic: When Li Linfu became chief minister and held real power at court, Li Linfu—Jiao's nephew—spoke of the matter at leisure in memorial, and sudden honors were therefore conferred.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.zh: 天寶十載，詔慶初尚新平公主，授駙馬都尉。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.literal: In the tenth year of Tianbao, an edict ordered Qingchu to marry Princess Xinping and appointed him commandant of the imperial son-in-law.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.idiomatic: In the tenth year of Tianbao, an edict ordered Qingchu to marry Princess Xinping and appointed him commandant of the imperial son-in-law.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.literal: In the first year of Yongtai, he was appointed minister of ceremonies.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-706c0f7.idiomatic: In the first year of Yongtai, he was appointed minister of ceremonies.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.zh: 子神勣，嗣聖元年，為左金吾將軍，則天使於巴州，害章懷太子，既而歸罪於神勣，左遷疊州刺史。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.literal: His son Shenji—in the first year of the Sisheng era, served as general of the Left Gold Crow Guard. When Zetian sent someone to Bazhou to kill Crown Prince Zhanghuai, blame was afterward placed on Shenji, and he was demoted to prefect of Die Prefecture.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.idiomatic: His son Shenji, in the first year of the Sisheng era, served as general of the Left Gold Crow Guard. When Zetian sent someone to Bazhou to kill Crown Prince Zhanghuai, blame was afterward placed on Shenji, and he was demoted to prefect of Die Prefecture.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.zh: 尋復入為左金吾衛大將軍，深見親委。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.literal: Soon he returned to court as grand general of the Left Gold Crow Guard and was deeply trusted and entrusted.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.idiomatic: Soon he returned to court as grand general of the Left Gold Crow Guard and was deeply trusted and entrusted.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.zh: 嘗受詔鞫獄，與周興、來俊臣等俱號為酷吏。
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.literal: He once received edict to interrogate prisoners, and together with Zhou Xing, Lai Junchen, and others was called a cruel official.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.idiomatic: He once received edict to interrogate prisoners, and together with Zhou Xing, Lai Junchen, and others was called a cruel official.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.literal: Soon he was executed for his crimes.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.idiomatic: Soon he was executed for his crimes.

source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.literal: At the beginning of the Shenlong era, his descendants were placed under restriction.
source-jiutangshu-063-wikisource-8b2fb79.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Shenlong era, his descendants were placed under restriction.
